In this lexicon

  • understand

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. And. 348: Obtundis, tametsī intellegō.; Traupman 32, 400; Traupman 26: quid dīcās ego nōn intellegō, I don’t understand what you are saying

Examples

  • Num tū intellegis hīc quid narret? — Num tū? — Nihil. — Tantundem ego.

    Do you understand what he’s saying? — Do you? — Not a thing. — Nor do I.Ter. Ph. 846
